notes.subject: עקרת הבית
notes.rationale: Construct 'barren-one of the house': 'barren woman of the household' (JPS) vs 'to keep house' (KJV) vs 'barren one of the house' (YLT).

notes.subject: ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Pronoun added to clarify whose house — Hebrew construct leaves the possessor implicit.

notes.subject: הללו יה
notes.rationale: Imperative summons to praise addressed to the hearers, closing the psalm.

notes.subject: הללו יה
notes.rationale: Direct plural address to the congregation.

translation: Min bɛ muso min ma se ka den sɔrɔ sigi ⟨a⟩ so kɔnɔ, a kɛra denw ba dɛrɛden ye — aw ye Ya duba.
